Warm, late afternoon or golden hour sunlight accentuates the folds of his clothing and the contours of his face, throwing dramatic contrast across the color-rich palette of burnt orange, deep reds, and gleaming browns. The composition is tightly framed, using shallow depth of field to softly blur the background, achieved with a digital camera, and focuses intently on the emotion and tradition of the scene. The overall tone is intimate, warm, and evocative of heritage.
